senses.definition: n.pr.terr. = Upper Egypt, Παθουρης, Φαθουρης, etc. (Egyptian p(ĕ)-tĕ-res, south land, in Assyrian Paturisi, ErmanZAW x (1890), 118 f. Steind BAS i. 344 WMM Hastings DB; also (on Assyrian) Schr KGF 283 f. DlPa 310);—always in connexion with מִצְרַיִם, etc.: Is 11:11; Je 44:15; Ez 30:14, אֶרֶץ פ׳ Je 44:1; Ez 29:14; מִפַּתְרֹס proposes also ψ 68:31 (for מִתְרַפֵּס) NeJBL x (1891), 152 (plausibly), cf. Che ib. xi (1892), 125 Kau ψψ crit. n..
